message.content:
方程式 \(x^{2}+2x+3=0\) 的判別式為  
\(D=b^{2}-4ac=4-12=-8<0\)，因此沒有實根，而是兩個共軛複數根：

\[
x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{D}}{2a}
   =\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{-8}}{2}
   =\frac{-2\pm i\,\sqrt{8}}{2}
   =-1 \pm i\sqrt{2}.
\]

所以解為  
\[
x_1=-1+i\sqrt{2},\qquad x_2=-1-i\sqrt{2}.
\]

Solve using quadratic formula: x = [-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)]/(2a). Here discriminant D = 4 - 12 = -8 < 0. So complex roots: x = (-2 ± sqrt(-8))/(2) = (-2 ± i*sqrt(8))/2 = (-2 ± i*2√2)/2 = -1 ± i√2. So solutions: x = -1 + i√2 and x = -1 - i√2.
